arguments.sql:
SELECT m.mcc, c.description, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id
JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc
WHERE c.description = 'Passenger Railways'
GROUP BY m.mcc, c.description
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, m.mcc
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions for each merchant category code whose description is exactly 'Passenger Railways'. Each code gets its own row.
assumptions: The description must match 'Passenger Railways' exactly, including case.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, including those with negative amounts or errors.
